name: The Gentlemen
description: The Gentlemen launched as a closed group in mid-2025 before opening as a full RaaS in September 2025, growing to 328 victims in the first five months of 2026 — roughly 10% of all global ransomware claims. Led by threat actor hastalamuerte/zeta88, a former Qilin affiliate. Offers affiliates a 90% revenue split, significantly above industry norms. In May 2026, their own backend infrastructure was breached, exposing internal operations.

ttps.notes: FortiGate and VPN appliance exploitation primary initial access
PowerShell used for Defender tampering and execution
Modifies auth and remote access registry settings
GPMC used to deploy malicious configurations domain-wide
Selective Microsoft Defender tampering via PowerShell
Selective event log clearing for defense evasion
PsExec over SMB admin shares for lateral movement
SystemBC SOCKS5 proxy for covert C2 and lateral movement
Per-file encryption with aggressive multi-vector self-propagation

notable_techniques: Multi-vector simultaneous lateral movement without dependency on prior success
NETLOGON share redeployment of encryptor after initial execution blocked
Supply chain reuse — stolen data from one victim used to attack their clients
May 2026 backend breach exposed internal chat logs, affiliate rosters, ransom negotiations
detection_opportunities: FortiGate admin account creation or modification
SystemBC SOCKS5 proxy beaconing to C2 infrastructure
PowerShell modifying Defender exclusions or disabling real-time protection
NETLOGON share access outside normal admin patterns
Selective event log clearing (Security, System logs)
